outerSurfaceRule: All roof bosses clipped by downward-filled exact native roof patches; no outward protrusion
speakerAssembly: Place speaker into open lower perimeter cradle; fit separate rear keeper; screw pair to roof bosses from below with cap detached. Nothing snaps through a closed lip.
amplifierAssembly: Prewire amp and clamp terminal wires on bench; two PCB mounting holes fasten to roof posts from below, with cap detached.
fastenerIntent: Four M2.5 x 8 tapping screws: speaker pair 5.01mm stack/2.99mm engagement; amp pair 1.57mm stack/6.43mm engagement. This is a geometric hardware requirement, not an inventory or purchase assertion.
